mechanism: Furosemide causes electrolyte depletion and volume depletion that may worsen anticholinergic-induced urinary retention and increase risk of dehydration; tolterodine's anticholinergic effects may increase dehydration risk in patients on loop diuretics.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes, and fluid balance regularly; assess post-void residual volume; counsel patients on adequate hydration and watch for signs of dehydration or urinary retention.
